chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali from Aban from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the man who has a wife with him, so he marries another, how much time should he make for the one he enters with? He said: Three days, then he should divide.
ai.seo_question: How long should a man spend with a new wife before dividing time between two wives?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the minimum duration of stay with a new wife before the obligation of equal time-sharing (kaffa) begins, establishing a three-day period as the threshold for this legal transition. This ruling highlights the practical application of justice in polygyny, ensuring the first wife's rights are not immediately diminished by the new marriage. The narration reflects the Shia juristic emphasis on balancing the husband's discretion with the wife's entitlement to consistent companionship.
